caption: the universe becomes a business sim: save DinerTown's diners from the Grub Burger chain, district by district.

req.note: 2003-2011 casual 2d, single-digit-to-double-digit-megabytes install. runs on anything, including hardware far below the target bar.

links.official_note: still sold on steam ($9.99) - one of the dash universe's surviving official doors. the archive routes below ride along for the original-era builds.

about: DinerTown Tycoon, released on 16 june 2009, steps outside the dash service loop entirely: it is a business management game about defending the neighbourhood's diners from the Grub burger chain. Districts are bought, venues are managed as a portfolio, and the dash cast's restaurants become the assets you protect.

The pace drops from five-minute shifts to a longer management curve - pricing, staffing and expansion replace the seating chart - and the campaign is won district by district. It is the only tycoon-style entry in the universe and the widest the franchise's core loop ever stretched.
The build reached steam in the playfirst batch and that listing still sells it, keeping the tycoon on the buyable side of the shelf.
